CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_PaymentCard_ATM] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard AS 
(
	--ISSUANCE_CARD--
SELECT
	BAI.CRD_ID AS PaymentCardId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardToken
	,NULL AS MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
	,NULL AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
	,NULL AS PaymentCardTypeId
	,NULL AS DebitCardIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardNote
	,BAI.CRD_BCR_ID AS PaymentCardCreationRequestId
	,BAI.CRD_PRS_ID AS ProgramId
	,BAI.CRD_INS_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BAI.CRD_BRN_ID AS BranchId
	,BAI.CRD_NUMBER AS PaymentCardNumber
	,BAI.CRD_EXPIRY_DATE AS PaymentCardExpiryDate
	,BAI.CRD_CREATION_DATE AS PaymentCardCreationDate
	,BAI.CRD_ALLOW_RENEWAL AS PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
	,BAI.CRD_IS_PRIMARY AS PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
	,BAI.CRD_KIT_NUMBER AS PaymentCardKitNumber
	,BAI.CRD_IS_LINKED AS PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
	,BAI.CRD_CTS_ID AS PaymentCardTransactionSetId
	,BAI.CRD_EMB_ID AS PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
	,BAI.CRD_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL AS OriginalBranchId
	,BAI.CRD_NUMBER_MASKED AS MaskedPaymentCardNumber
	,BAI.CRD_CCL_ID AS CorporateClientId
	,BAI.CRD_IS_CARD_POSTED AS PaymentCardPostedIndicator
	,BAI.CRD_SEQUENCE_NUMBER AS PaymentCardSequenceNumber
	,BAI.CRD_LIFE_CYCLE AS PaymentCardLifeCycleId
	,BAI.CRD_IS_CORPORATE AS PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
	,BAI.CRD_CORPORATE_NAME AS CorporateName
	,BAI.CRD_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER AS PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
	,BAI.CRD_PIN_GENERATED AS PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardShortName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardClosedDate
	,NULL AS EmbossingDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardGroup
	,NULL AS PaymentCardFormatId
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
	,NULL AS MemberSinceDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BAI.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM  BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD BAI WHERE BAI.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

	--ISSUANCE_CASH_CARD--
SELECT
	BAC.CSH_ID AS PaymentCardId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardToken
	,NULL AS MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
	,NULL AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
	,NULL AS PaymentCardTypeId
	,NULL AS DebitCardIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardNote
	,BAC.CSH_BCR_ID AS PaymentCardCreationRequestId
	,BAC.CSH_PRS_ID AS ProgramId
	,BAC.CSH_INS_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BAC.CSH_BRN_ID AS BranchId
	,BAC.CSH_CARD_NUMBER AS PaymentCardNumber
	,BAC.CSH_EXPIRY_DATE AS PaymentCardExpiryDate
	,BAC.CSH_CREATION_DATE AS PaymentCardCreationDate
	,BAC.CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL AS PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
	,BAC.CSH_IS_PRIMARY AS PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
	,BAC.CSH_KIT_NUMBER AS PaymentCardKitNumber
	,BAC.CSH_IS_LINKED AS PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
	,BAC.CSH_CTS_ID AS PaymentCardTransactionSetId
	,BAC.CSH_EMB_ID AS PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
	,BAC.CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL AS OriginalBranchId
	,BAC.CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED AS MaskedPaymentCardNumber
	,BAC.CSH_CCL_ID AS CorporateClientId
	,BAC.CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED AS PaymentCardPostedIndicator
	,BAC.CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER AS PaymentCardSequenceNumber
	,BAC.CSH_LIFE_CYCLE AS PaymentCardLifeCycleId
	,BAC.CSH_IS_CORPORATE AS PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
	,BAC.CSH_CORPORATE_NAME AS CorporateName
	,BAC.CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER AS PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
	,BAC.CSH_PIN_GENERATED AS PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardShortName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardClosedDate
	,NULL AS EmbossingDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardGroup
	,NULL AS PaymentCardFormatId
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
	,NULL AS MemberSinceDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BAC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM  BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD BAC WHERE BAC.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 convert(varchar,PaymentCardId)
,convert(varchar,PaymentCardToken)
,convert(varchar,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber)
,convert(varchar,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName)
,convert(int,PaymentCardIssuedDate)
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,PaymentCardTypeId
,DebitCardIndicator
,PaymentCardNote
,PaymentCardCreationRequestId
,ProgramId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,PaymentCardNumber
,PaymentCardExpiryDate
,convert(date,PaymentCardCreationDate)
,PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
,PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
,PaymentCardKitNumber
,PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
,PaymentCardTransactionSetId
,PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
,OriginalBranchId
,MaskedPaymentCardNumber
,CorporateClientId
,PaymentCardPostedIndicator
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardLifeCycleId
,PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
,CorporateName
,PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
,PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
)) HASHROW, PaymentCardId, PaymentCardIssuedDate, PaymentCardTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 convert(varchar,PaymentCardId)
,convert(varchar,PaymentCardToken)
,convert(varchar,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber)
,convert(varchar,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName)
,convert(int,PaymentCardIssuedDate)
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,PaymentCardTypeId
,DebitCardIndicator
,PaymentCardNote
,PaymentCardCreationRequestId
,ProgramId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,PaymentCardNumber
,PaymentCardExpiryDate
,convert(date,PaymentCardCreationDate)
,PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
,PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
,PaymentCardKitNumber
,PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
,PaymentCardTransactionSetId
,PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
,OriginalBranchId
,MaskedPaymentCardNumber
,CorporateClientId
,PaymentCardPostedIndicator
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardLifeCycleId
,PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
,CorporateName
,PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
,PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
))  HASHROW, PaymentCardId, PaymentCardIssuedDate, PaymentCardTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId
  FROM BNKM.PaymentCard WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'	
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.PaymentCardId,TGT.PaymentCardId) AS PaymentCardId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate,TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate) AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
	,ISNULL(SRC.PaymentCardTypeId,TGT.PaymentCardTypeId) AS PaymentCardTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
AND SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
AND SRC.PaymentCardTypeId = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA;



---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	PaymentCardId = SRC.PaymentCardId
	,PaymentCardToken = NULL
	,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber = NULL
	,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName = NULL
	,PaymentCardIssuedDate = NULL
	,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp = NULL
	,PaymentCardTypeId = NULL
	,DebitCardIndicator = NULL
	,PaymentCardNote = NULL
	,PaymentCardCreationRequestId = SRC.PaymentCardCreationRequestId
	,ProgramId = SRC.ProgramId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
	,PaymentCardNumber = SRC.PaymentCardNumber
	,PaymentCardExpiryDate = SRC.PaymentCardExpiryDate
	,PaymentCardCreationDate = SRC.PaymentCardCreationDate
	,PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
	,PaymentCardPrimayIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
	,PaymentCardKitNumber = SRC.PaymentCardKitNumber
	,PaymentCardLinkedIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
	,PaymentCardTransactionSetId = SRC.PaymentCardTransactionSetId
	,PaymentCardEmbossingFileId = SRC.PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
	,OriginalBranchId = SRC.OriginalBranchId
	,MaskedPaymentCardNumber = SRC.MaskedPaymentCardNumber
	,CorporateClientId = SRC.CorporateClientId
	,PaymentCardPostedIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardPostedIndicator
	,PaymentCardSequenceNumber = SRC.PaymentCardSequenceNumber
	,PaymentCardLifeCycleId = SRC.PaymentCardLifeCycleId
	,PaymentCardCorporateIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
	,CorporateName = SRC.CorporateName
	,PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId = SRC.PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
	,PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator = SRC.PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
	,PaymentCardShortName = NULL
	,PaymentCardHolderTypeId = NULL
	,PaymentCardClosedDate = NULL
	,EmbossingDate = NULL
	,PaymentCardGroup = NULL
	,PaymentCardFormatId = NULL
	,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit = NULL
	,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit = NULL
	,PaymentCardLastActivationDate = NULL
	,MemberSinceDate = NULL
	,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp = NULL
	,SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.PaymentCard TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA ON convert(varchar,DELTA.PaymentCardId) = convert(varchar,TGT.PaymentCardId)  
AND DELTA.PaymentCardIssuedDate = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
AND DELTA.PaymentCardTypeId = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC ON convert(varchar,SRC.PaymentCardId) = convert(varchar,TGT.PaymentCardId) 
AND SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
AND SRC.PaymentCardTypeId = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'	
;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCard
(
	PaymentCardId
	,PaymentCardToken
	,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
	,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
	,PaymentCardIssuedDate
	,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
	,PaymentCardTypeId
	,DebitCardIndicator
	,PaymentCardNote
	,PaymentCardCreationRequestId
	,ProgramId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,BranchId
	,PaymentCardNumber
	,PaymentCardExpiryDate
	,PaymentCardCreationDate
	,PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
	,PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
	,PaymentCardKitNumber
	,PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
	,PaymentCardTransactionSetId
	,PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
	,OriginalBranchId
	,MaskedPaymentCardNumber
	,CorporateClientId
	,PaymentCardPostedIndicator
	,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
	,PaymentCardLifeCycleId
	,PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
	,CorporateName
	,PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
	,PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
	,PaymentCardShortName
	,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
	,PaymentCardClosedDate
	,EmbossingDate
	,PaymentCardGroup
	,PaymentCardFormatId
	,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
	,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
	,PaymentCardLastActivationDate
	,MemberSinceDate
	,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	SRC.PaymentCardId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardToken
	,NULL AS MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
	,NULL AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
	,NULL AS PaymentCardTypeId
	,NULL AS DebitCardIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardNote
	,SRC.PaymentCardCreationRequestId
	,SRC.ProgramId
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.BranchId
	,SRC.PaymentCardNumber
	,SRC.PaymentCardExpiryDate
	,SRC.PaymentCardCreationDate
	,SRC.PaymentCardAllowRenewalIndicator
	,SRC.PaymentCardPrimayIndicator
	,SRC.PaymentCardKitNumber
	,SRC.PaymentCardLinkedIndicator
	,SRC.PaymentCardTransactionSetId
	,SRC.PaymentCardEmbossingFileId
	,SRC.OriginalBranchId
	,SRC.MaskedPaymentCardNumber
	,SRC.CorporateClientId
	,SRC.PaymentCardPostedIndicator
	,SRC.PaymentCardSequenceNumber
	,SRC.PaymentCardLifeCycleId
	,SRC.PaymentCardCorporateIndicator
	,SRC.CorporateName
	,SRC.PaymentCardKeyRotationNumberId
	,SRC.PaymentCardPinGeneratedIndicator
	,NULL AS PaymentCardShortName
	,NULL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
	,NULL AS PaymentCardClosedDate
	,NULL AS EmbossingDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardGroup
	,NULL AS PaymentCardFormatId
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
	,NULL AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
	,NULL AS MemberSinceDate
	,NULL AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
	,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA ON convert(varchar,DELTA.PaymentCardId) = convert(varchar,SRC.PaymentCardId)  
AND DELTA.PaymentCardIssuedDate = SRC.PaymentCardIssuedDate
AND DELTA.PaymentCardTypeId = SRC.PaymentCardTypeId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA;


END
GO
